question:
Simplify.

17 - 4 × (5.4 ÷ 9) + 6 × 1.9
solution:
**Calculations:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7daff15273b9247645266894c4cf2124ace4615ea5e37b656e05cc83cddfbd8c.png] **

Solve as per above given method

⇒ 17 – 4 × (5.4 ÷ 9) + 6 × 1.9

⇒ 17 - 4 × 0.6 + 11.4

⇒ 17 - 2.4 + 11.4

⇒ 17 + 9

⇒ 26

**∴ The correct choice is option 1.**
